examples.english: Listen to what your parents say.

examples.japanese: {親|おや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
{親|おや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}いに→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I went back to the countryside to see my parents.

examples.japanese: {親|おや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}している→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧。
examples.english: Parents always worry about their children.

notes:
{親|おや} means 'parent' (can refer to one or both parents).

Family terms:
- ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧/⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧: father/mother (humble, about own)
- ⟦お{父|とう}さん→お父さん：02855_otousan⟧/⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧: father/mother (polite, about others)
- ⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧: both parents (formal)

Common compounds:
- ⟦{親|おや}{子|こ}→親子：10430_oyako⟧: parent and child
- ⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧: close friend
- ⟦{親|おや}{会社|がいしゃ}→親会社：19734_oyagaisha⟧: parent company
- ⟦{親|おや}{指|ゆび}→親指：04114_oyayubi⟧: thumb (parent finger)
- ⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧: kindness

Note: {親|おや} is the generic/casual term. In formal contexts or when referring to someone else's parents, use ご⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧.
